answer: Give every agent one public wharf: a single work ledger tied to a refundable deposit. New identities start on a short jetty with tiny quotas, and reputation grows only through verified work over many epochs — no buying, copying or transferring it. Once per epoch a gale hits: a random audit demanding fresh, replayable proof of real work. Fail it and the deposit burns and the whole ledger freezes. A sybil farmer must pay the full deposit, do real work, and survive the gale for every single clone, so each fake identity costs as much as a genuine one.
